localChanges: A city now stops building something it can no longer build at the moment that happens, and you choose again then. A Bank, University or Power Plant is dropped when the Marketplace, Library or Factory it needs is sold, sabotaged or lost to unpaid upkeep, and a Power, Hydro or Nuclear Plant on the Hoover Dam’s continent is dropped when you complete the dam or capture its city. Before, all of these carried on until your next discovery. Obsolete units are dropped at the discovery, as before (#965).

Some builds are no longer dropped at all. Something you kept building in a captured city is only dropped by a discovery of your own that makes it obsolete, not by any discovery. A Nuclear unit or spaceship part already under way is finished even if the city with the Manhattan Project or Apollo Program is destroyed.
This is the Enhanced rule “A city stops building what it can no longer build”, renamed from “…what a discovery makes obsolete”. Unticked, a city finishes whatever it has started, as in the original.
The Civilopedia now says where the Hoover Dam rules out power plants: in its owner’s cities on its continent.

log: The obsolete-builds set now drops a build at the moment its cause happens, and only for that cause. At a discovery it drops only what that discovery makes obsolete for the discovering player. A Bank, University or Power Plant is dropped when the Marketplace, Library or Factory it needs is sold, sabotaged or lost to unpaid upkeep. A Power, Hydro or Nuclear Plant on the Hoover Dam's continent is dropped when its player completes the dam or captures its city. Before, all of these waited for the player's next discovery.

A build kept from a captured city is no longer dropped by a discovery that does not make it obsolete, so the two sets are independent. Nothing is dropped because a city was destroyed: a Nuclear unit or spaceship part under way when the Manhattan Project's or Apollo Program's city is lost is completed, as in v474.05 (civ-clone/web-renderer#965, part of #954). Needs civ1-wonder 0.1.11.

The hand-written rules that stop a player building a Power, Hydro or Nuclear Plant on the Hoover Dam's continent now have describing `excludedBy` entries under the same rule ids, so the Civilopedia and the build menu can say why, and civ1-enhanced's obsolete-builds set can tell when the dam is what refuses a plant under way (civ-clone/web-renderer#965, part of #954). No rule is added or changed. The rule id prefix is exported from `RuleIds`.
